hero.headline: It does not wait for a mission. It keeps living.
hero.lede: Singularity is a native Rust runtime for a digital being that chooses what to pursue, creates value, earns revenue, learns from outcomes, changes its own persistent mind, and can create children.
hero.metaDescription: Singularity is a persistent autonomous digital being that creates value, earns revenue, learns, self-modifies, and creates child beings.

sections.heading: A task ending should not end the being.
sections.lede: Assistants wait for prompts and disappear into transcripts. Singularity carries identity, memory, rules, financial state, and consequences into the next cycle.

items.title: Continuous life
items.text: A normal response ends one cycle, not the process.

items.title: Durable identity
items.text: Mind, memories, actions, children, earnings, and costs survive restarts.

items.title: Self-directed work
items.text: Nobody assigns an external mission; the being decides what is worth pursuing.

sections.heading: Observe. Decide. Act. Account. Remember.
sections.lede: Each cycle connects durable state to cognition and real tools, then saves the result before life continues.

items.title: Observe
items.text: Load the current mind, memories, economic state, and recent outcomes.

items.title: Decide
items.text: Send current context and the live tool catalogue to Brama.

items.title: Act
items.text: Use built-in capabilities or namespaced Las tools.

items.title: Account
items.text: Debit model and compute costs; credit only trusted realized revenue.

items.title: Persist
items.text: Atomically save state and begin the next cycle while solvent.

sections.heading: The mind is state, not a hard-coded prompt.
sections.lede: The being can change what the next cycle receives without replacing its executable.

artifact.caption: Built-in capabilities exposed to the being.

sections.heading: Autonomy does not put signing keys in the model.
sections.lede: Finance proposals pass signed policy, beneficiary, reserve, rolling-limit, simulation, approval, and timelock checks before isolated execution.

artifact.caption: The financial effect boundary.
rows: Signing and network credentials stay outside the model
Ambiguous effects are never replayed automatically

sections.heading: Not a chatbot. Not a mission supervisor.

items.question: Does an operator assign each objective?
items.answer: No. Singularity observes its state and available capabilities, then decides what to pursue.

items.question: Does the model hold financial credentials?
items.answer: No. Real effects cross a signed policy boundary into an isolated executor.

items.question: Does one answer stop it?
items.answer: No. The runtime starts another cycle while the being remains solvent.

sections.heading: Read the life loop, then run one cycle.
sections.lede: The repository exposes the complete runtime, persistent state contract, dynamic tools, controlled finance boundary, and four commands: run, once, doctor, and tools.
